The '''Terhana Library''' is located in [[Bandar Eban]]. According to [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]], it is one of the greatest in the world, and as such, [[Domani]] librarians are not uncommon.

[[Namine Tasil]], a Domani [[Aes Sedai]], may have spent some time in the Terhana Library before going to the [[White Tower]], as she chose the [[Brown Ajah]] and settled in the [[White Tower Library|library]] there when she was raised to the [[shawl]].
